title: The Public Theater is one of my favorite Off-Broadway venues, and The...
transcript: Finding the perfect pre show meal can be tough sometimes, which is why I was so excited to be invited to come check out the Astor, the brand new restaurant at the Public Theater. And I have to just gush about the interior for a second cause they did such a good job decorating. The walls are completely covered in so many photographs and theater memorabilia. Of course, there are things from mainstream shows like Hamilton and A Chorus Line, both of which started at the Public Theater, but there were also some deep cuts like a jacket from The Runaways and a fortress of solitude playbill. I could literally spend an hour just walking around and looking at all of it. It just made for such a cool ambience While we enjoyed our meal, which by the way, was excellent, we tried the beef in Wellington appetizer, and then for our main, we both got the Tavern Burger. But for me, the real standout was this chocolate cheesecake. Like seriously, if you go get the cheesecake, it is so good, you will not be disappointed. And then when we were done, we just walked downstairs and we were basically at the theater. The Public Theater always has multiple shows going on at once, but all of the theaters are in the same building, so whichever show you're seeing, the Astor is a really great option for pre or post show dinner or drinks.
classificationReason: This is a restaurant/venue review of the Astor at the Public Theater — covers food, decor, and ambience, not any specific stage production.
